messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026-1145 — service=runtime-router-us-east, symptom=high p99 latency >1200ms over 2m :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-1145 escalated to on-call (emma_oncall). PagerDuty link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-1145
emma_oncall: acked. I'm taking initial triage. I'll gather metrics and try fast mitigations. @alex_support can you pull any customer reports? :wave:
alex_support: got two tickets from enterprise accounts in us-east complaining about timeouts ~10m ago. One opened a support escalation. I'll DM customer list and pass updates.
maria_serving: seeing huge enqueue times on pool "inference-rtg-us-east-3" — queue_length spikes and GPU utilization at ~95%. Some pods logging "kv_cache allocation failed" around the same time. No full node OOMs yet.
raj_sre: pinging infra — any recent deploys or config changes? I don't see any CI deploys in the last 30m.
emma_oncall: no deploys from us. Looks like runtime pressure. I'll try scale-up and rolling restart of router first. If that doesn't help, we'll fallback-route to secondary region and spin up quantized variant.
maria_serving: concur. Recommending: (1) temporarily increase pool replicas from 4 -> 8, (2) disable prefix caching to reduce memory pressure, (3) route a small percentage to us-west as canary.
emma_oncall: executing scale now. Running kubectl command.
```
# scale replica set for inference pool
kubectl -n inference set replicas deploy/inference-rtg-us-east-3 8
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-rtg-us-east-3 --watch
```

emma_oncall: started rollout. Will post updates. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: if incident remains unacknowledged by the next policy (SRE lead), escalation scheduled in 5m.
raj_sre: I'll standby to take over if needed. Can you also post p99 latency and error-rate numbers?
emma_oncall: initial numbers from observability: p95=420ms, p99=1360ms, error rate (5xx/timeouts)=7.2% over last 10m. Traffic concentrated to a handful of customers — top 3 customers account for ~38% of requests.
alex_support: confirming customers: Acme Inc, Brightline, NovaPay all reported timeouts. I'm sending them a brief update: "We are investigating elevated inference latency and routing mitigations are in progress. Will follow up within 15 minutes."
maria_serving: scale completed on pool, but one pod failed to come up cleanly (OOMKilled). Log excerpt: "runtime: allocate failed: kv cache memory exceeds limit". I am applying config to reduce cache size for that pool.
```
# reduce kv_cache_size for pool
redwoodctl pools update inference-rtg-us-east-3 --kv-cache-size=256MB
```

maria_serving: applying autoscale override to allow burst to 12 replicas until 60m.
raj_sre: I'm initiating rolling restart of runtime-router pods to clear transient state. Command: `kubectl -n runtime rollout restart ds/runtime-router-us-east`
emma_oncall: after scale + restart, error rate dropped to 1.1% and p99 dropped to ~380ms. Still above SLO but much better. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: INC-2026-1145 acknowledged by emma_oncall at 1840129879.
maria_serving: additional observation: there are several long-running KV cache entries for some prompt-heavy jobs (large context lengths). We've temporarily disabled prefix/KV caching for a subset of customers to prioritize stability.
raj_sre: taking over ownership at 1840130500 — I'm going to continue mitigation and root cause triage. @emma_oncall handoff accepted. I'll keep updating thread. :hand:
emma_oncall: handoff: actions taken -> scaled pool 4->8, applied kv_cache reduction, enabled autoscale override, restarted runtime-router. Outcome -> error rate 7.2% -> 0.9%, p99 1360ms -> 220-400ms range. Leaving logs/commands in #incident-runbooks.
alex_support: customers notified of mitigations and that we're monitoring. No further escalations so far.
raj_sre: next steps: collect heap/dump from the failed pod, correlate request patterns to prompt lengths, check kernel allocation stats on GPUs, and review recent model hotpatches. Assigning myself to the PD incident and adding SRE lead to bridge.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026-1145 ownership transferred to raj_sre. Escalation paused.
maria_serving: grabbing pod debug info now — saving to /var/tmp/inc-1145-dumps, will upload to the incident ticket.
raj_sre: FYI I'm enabling temporary routing policy to route 15% of traffic to us-west for high-risk customers while we validate stability here.
emma_oncall: thanks team — I'll prep the initial incident report and timeline. Tagging @maria_serving for post-mortem details about kv_cache sizing.
alex_support: I'll follow up with the three impacted customers with a short RCA-lite once we have a baseline. Keeping support channel open.
pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-1145 status updated: Mitigation in progress. Next status check due in 20m.
raj_sre: current metrics: p99=240ms, error rate=0.8%, user impact decreased from 3.1% of total requests to 0.2%. Marking as stable for now; will keep autoscale override for 30m.
emma_oncall: closing my on-call handover — leaving notes in the ticket and assigning postmortem owner to maria_serving. Good work. :tada:
incident-bot: If no regressions occur, please update PD to resolved and file postmortem doc.
raj_sre: will follow up and close PD after 30m stable window. Postmortem owner: maria_serving.
maria_serving: acknowledged. Saving timeline and action items to incident tracker.
pagerduty-bot: INC-2026-1145 marked as resolved at 1840132100 by raj_sre.
emma_oncall: thanks everyone, prepping a short blameless summary for #postmortems.
alex_support: standing by for any customer follow-ups.
